scripts.check: npm run check:types && npm run check:format && npm run check:lint
scripts.check:types: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json
scripts.check:format: prettier --check package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json .prettierrc.json eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts packages/contracts packages/domain tools/quality apps/api
scripts.check:lint: eslint eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts packages/contracts packages/domain tools/quality apps/api
scripts.build: npm run contracts:generate && tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/domain/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.build.json
